cases.requirement: A minimal consumer of Colosseum's selected libtorrent target must configure, compile, link, and run on Windows and the selected Linux qualification lane.
Removing the required libtorrent dependency must fail configuration visibly rather than falling back to a success-shaped build.
cases.accepted_observation: Linux negative configure exited 1 when LibtorrentRasterbar was disabled.

cases.requirement: Compile-time header identity, runtime library identity, and binary dependency inspection must agree while Boost, OpenSSL, Qt, compiler, CRT/linkage assumptions are recorded.
